postvault.description:
PostVault turns your pile of saved posts into an organised, searchable library. Share a post to it and it files the post into a collection, writes a short description and pulls out every link it mentions.

- Save from the share sheet: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and X
- Automatic collections, plus your own custom ones
- AI description and extracted links for every post
- Search all saves or inside one collection, and add your own notes
- Export and import backups; pictures are kept on your phone
- Light and dark liquid-glass design

Open source. No ads, no tracking.
